(async () => { const g = __game.game; const m = PF.member('elder'); const s0 = g.party.stats.snaps; m.placeAt(40, 30); await PF.frame(); await PF.frame(); const d = Math.hypot(m.position.x - g.player.position.x, m.position.z - g.player.position.z); PF.expect(g.party.stats.snaps === s0 + 1 && d < 17, 'a member 25 u away is put behind the player at once (the snap): ' + JSON.stringify([g.party.stats.snaps - s0, d.toFixed(2), m.follow.mode])); const ok = await PF.until(() => m.follow.mode === 'trail', 8000); PF.expect(ok, 'and takes the trail again: ' + m.follow.mode); await PF.sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ snapped: g.party.stats.snaps - s0, d: +d.toFixed(2), rejoined: ok, members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const m = PF.member('innkeeper'); const pl = g.player; pl.facing.set(0, 0, -1); pl.sprite.faceVector(0, -1); __game.teleport(24.5, 19.5); await PF.sleep(500); const route = [[24.75, 18.2], [25, 18], [25, 16], [25, 14], [25, 7.6]]; const bad = PF.checkRoute([24.5, 19.5], route); m.direct(); m.placeAt(23.75, 19); const nav = g.party._navFor(); const buf = new Float32Array(512); const apart = nav.findPath(23.75, 19, 25, 8.5, 60, buf); const s0 = g.party.stats.snaps; const r = await PF.drive(route, { label: 'up the stairs, a member held in the plaza' }); m.release(); let crumb = false; let ok = false; const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 12000) { await PF.frame(); crumb ||= m.follow.crumb !== null; if (m.follow.mode === 'trail' && m.position.z < 12.5 && Math.hypot(m.position.x - pl.position.x, m.position.z - pl.position.z) < 4) { ok = true; break; } } const ms = Math.round(performance.now() - t0); PF.expect(r.reached && bad.length === 0, 'the player walked from the plaza between the lamppost and the house up the stairs: ' + JSON.stringify([r.player, bad])); PF.expect(apart <= 0, 'the walk grid joins no way from the plaza to the stairs (the case under test): ' + apart); PF.expect(ok && crumb && g.party.stats.snaps === s0, 'a member left in the plaza runs back along the player\'s way (no way on the walk grid), up the stairs, no snap: ' + JSON.stringify([ok, crumb, g.party.stats.snaps - s0, ms, PF.brief()])); const brief = PF.brief(); pl.facing.set(-1, 0, 0); pl.sprite.faceVector(-1, 0); __game.teleport(16.4, 7.4); await PF.sleep(800); return JSON.stringify({ apart, crumb, ok, ms, members: brief }); })()
